title: Understanding Feature Weights
text: In logistic regression, the magnitude of a feature's weight indicates its influence on the prediction. A higher magnitude means the feature has a stronger impact.

title: Standardized Features
text: Since the features are standardized, they have a mean of $$0$$ and a standard deviation of $$1$$. This allows us to directly compare the magnitudes of the weights.

title: Interpreting Weight Magnitudes
text: If the abv feature has a higher magnitude weight than the hue feature, it suggests that abv is more influential in determining the wine type.

title: Comparing Feature Influence
text: Given that both features are standardized, which feature is likely to have a higher magnitude weight based on its influence on the wine type?
